title: The Taken Child
text: A recruit sleeping in the barracks was gone at dawn, the blankets still warm, the door still barred. A trail of black leaves leads across the yard, through the streets and on to the Rift Gate. The Hollow Wood has taken one of ours, and someone must go and bring them back.

options.label: Keep a vigil at the Gate so they can find their way home.

outcomes.text: Every night candles burn at the Gate, and the town helps you keep them lit.

options.label: Leave the wood an offering, in case it is open to a trade.

outcomes.text: In the morning the offering is gone, and nothing else is.
The offering is gone, and a second bed is empty.

options.label: Keep it quiet; it is only a recruit.

outcomes.text: The barracks talk anyway, and so does the town.
